prompt: Correct ONLY the bottom-left A03 Library helical stair SECTION on this four-part palace stair sheet. Its central shaft and upper rail are currently clipped by the top cell boundary. Make it a FINITE uncropped quarter-turn module: shorten the centre support shaft so it ends at a visible plain flat receiving plane JUST ABOVE the highest tread/upper landing of this section. Remove the long column extending outside the picture; no huge tall room column. Keep all radial wedge treads, curved source open gold/ivory rail, complete lower base and upper landing. Fit the ENTIRE resulting A03 including both rail ends/support top inside its cell with clean white margin above and around. Do not shrink/crop other cells or remove necessary support; match original ivory/rose/gold and blue inlay palette. A01 Ballroom, A02 Throne, A04 Conservatory stay exactly as shown. Keep title and all four exact IDs AND names unchanged and legible. No whole room, new stair types, plants, pots or extra furniture. Clear end planes for a proposed modular join, no physical-fit guarantee written onto the image.

repeat_contract.linear_flight: Repeated tread segments at consistent rise/run, terminate at separate landing
repeat_contract.dais: Three shallow rises; spans later normalize to throne platform width
repeat_contract.helical: Quarter-turn segments rotate90 degrees around same centre and increase height by segment rise; wedge treads follow common inner/outer radius
repeat_contract.conservatory: Two low dry rises; water-channel coping stays a separate object

dimension_policy: Illustrative human-scale starting dimensions, not source measurements or confirmed palace level dimensions. Helical bounds/inner and outer radii must normalize before joining.
original_prompt:
Make a clean high-resolution named component reference sheet, not a whole room/building. Use ONLY the one supplied source for material/motif vocabulary. Owner-requested new variations and junctions must stay coordinated with it. Separate complete objects, no fused neighbors, no cropped silhouettes, no shadows over patterns, no melting scrolls or warped rails. Straight edges/columns remain straight; thin gold stays thin. Warm-white background, even light. Print exact full ID AND short name below EVERY item, title above. One object per cell, no duplicate alternate views. Palette/style follows this source. Source illustrations are not measured models; do not invent fixed palace dimensions. No people, whole buildings, scenery, plants or loose decoration glued onto parts.

Source illustrates complete room stairs; segment backs/landings and proposed heights are new modular interpretations, not measured full-room reconstructions. Existing PAL-STAIR-001 remains the outdoor source wing stair; do not replace it with these indoor variants.
